Exam Date & Time: 02-Jan-2023 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS - JANUARY 2023  
  SUBJECT: CIE 1072 / CIE-1072 - ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES [CIE 1072]  
Marks: 50                                                                          Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          What was Charles David Keeling's major contribution to climate science?  
  (5)  
  
1B)             Why were high-yield variety (HYV) seeds introduced in India and what were the short-  
  term and long-term effects of it?                                                    (5)  
  
2A)             Explain the various sources of nuclear pollution.  
  (5)  
  
2B)             Oceans are the destination of all natural and manmade pollutants as rivers discharge  
  their pollutants into the sea. Comment on the same.                                     (5)  
  
3A)             Discuss three acts related to water pollution and prevention.  
  (5)  
  
3B)             What are the functions of the state pollution control board?  
  (5)  
  
4A)             Explain the various steps involved in EIA.  
  (5)  
  
4B)             With the help of a neat sketch explain Bottom pressure recording network in detecting  
  and reporting tsunamis.                                                                 (5)  
  
5A)             Comment on the factors influencing scale of disaster.  
  (5)  
  
5B)             Discuss on application of drones and artificial intelligence in disaster response and  
  resilience.                                                                             (5)  
  
  
-----End-----
